Introduction

B.Dolls was a South Korean 4-member group that debuted on August 26, 2010 under Harvest International. In the latter part of their career, the group consisted of Geunyoung, Hayeon, Yewon and Seo I. They have been inactive since February 2011, leading to the assumption that the group has unofficially disbanded.
